rows.title: Skagit and Cascade River fishing updates
rows.teaser: Postpones opening of fishing seasons in upper areas of the Skagit River and Cascade River and temporarily closes all fishing in the Skagit River from Gilligan Creek east of Sedro-Wolley to the Dalles Bridge near Concrete. This rule also red

rows.title: Yakima River fall salmon fishery to open
rows.teaser: Opens the lower Yakima River salmon retention.

rows.title: Lower Columbia River salmon and steelhead fishery update
rows.teaser: Allows retention of one additional adult hatchery coho as part of the daily limit from the Buoy 10 line upstream to the west end of Puget Island.

rows.title: Quillayute River closing to all fishing due to low flows and poor water conditions
rows.teaser: Closes fishing.

rows.title: Marine Area 9 (Admiralty Inlet), Marine Area 12 (Hood Canal) shellfish beaches update
rows.teaser: Rescinds biotoxin-related closure of public shellfish beaches in Dabob and Quilcene bays and at Belfair State Park; and opens oyster harvest at Point Whitney Tidelands and Lagoon. Maintains other previously announced shellfish beach closure

rows.title: Marine Area 1 (Ilwaco) recreational salmon season update
rows.teaser: Opens five days of hatchery coho retention (Sept. 4–8) with a nearshore salmon fishing closure.

rows.title: Daily limits removed from Fish Lake ahead of rehabilitation
rows.teaser: Opens fishing with no size restrictions or daily limit for all species.

rows.title: Stevens Creek to close to fishing in September
rows.teaser: Closes game fish angling in Stevens Creek.

rows.title: Entiat River to close for summer Chinook fishing
rows.teaser: Closes salmon fishing.

rows.title: Marine Area 4 (Neah Bay) salmon possession rules update
rows.teaser: Allows salmon legally caught in Canada and Marine Areas east of Sekiu River (Marine Areas 5-13) to be transported through Marine Area 4 (Neah Bay) and landed in Neah Bay. Maintains salmon closure in Marine Area 4 (Neah Bay).

rows.title: Lower Naselle River gear restriction update
rows.teaser: Rescinds requirement for bait or lure to be suspended below a float, except when trolling from a floating device, beginning Oct. 15.

rows.title: Marine Area 4 (Neah Bay) recreational salmon season closes Aug. 24
rows.teaser: Closes salmon fishing, and prohibits possession of salmon onboard a vessel.

rows.title: Upper Green (Duwamish) River closed to fishing from Sept. 16–Oct. 31
rows.teaser: Closes all fishing.

rows.title: Green (Duwamish) River Chinook retention closed
rows.teaser: Closes Chinook salmon retention.

rows.title: Marine Area 2 (Westport – Ocean Shores) recreational salmon season update
rows.teaser: Closes Chinook retention and possession onboard a vessel.

rows.title: Puget Sound recreational crabbing update, Marine Area 7 North opens Aug. 15
rows.teaser: Opens Puget Sound summer crab season in Marine Area 7 North Thursday through Monday each week, from Aug. 15–Sept. 28, 2026.

rows.title: Marine Area 11 (Tacoma and Vashon Island) salmon fishery update
rows.teaser: Closes Chinook salmon retention.

rows.title: Fall Chinook harvest to open in the Snake River
rows.teaser: Opens Chinook salmon retention in areas of the Snake River.

rows.title: Summer halibut fishery 2026
rows.effective: Effective August 8 – September 30, 2026 (See below for specific open days in each area.)
rows.teaser: Opens halibut dates in August and September. Annual halibut limit is six. Anglers may clean and portion halibut in the field but must retain the fish carcass until coming ashore.

rows.title: Puget Sound shrimp fishery update
rows.teaser: Opens the fishery for all shrimp in Marine Area 6 except in the Discovery Bay Shrimp District on August 2.
tags: All shrimp species which include spot shrimp

rows.title: Marine Area 4 (Neah Bay) recreational salmon seasons
rows.teaser: Opens Marine Area 4 salmon fisheries.

rows.title: Marine Area 3 (La Push) recreational salmon seasons
rows.teaser: Opens Marine Area 3 salmon fisheries.

rows.title: Marine Area 2 (Westport – Ocean Shores) recreational salmon seasons
rows.teaser: Opens Marine Area 2 salmon fisheries.

rows.title: Marine Area 1 (Ilwaco) recreational salmon season
rows.teaser: Opens Marine Area 1 salmon fisheries.
